name: mcp__html__html_outline
description: The reading view of an HTML file: one element per line, indented one space per level, each with an @n ref, and text as "| text" lines. Scripts, styles, comments, SVG content, hidden content and most attributes are left out. Returns one page of at most 20,000 tokens and the file hash. Use html_find instead when you know some of the text you want.

name: mcp__html__html_find
description: Finds the elements whose visible text contains a literal, case-sensitive string. For each deepest match (at most 20), returns its outline line and its ancestors' lines, with @n refs, then the total count of matches and the file hash.

name: mcp__html__html_read
description: Returns one element, by its @n ref, as the exact bytes of the file, with all attributes.

hash.description: The hash from html_outline or html_find

name: mcp__html__html_edit
description: Replaces one element, by its @n ref, with new HTML (an empty string removes it). The rest of the file keeps its bytes. Fails if the file changed since the hash, or if the HTML is not a balanced fragment.
